tasks.how: Attend the kickoff, Note milestones and imporatnt dates
tasks.check: Scope, platforms, slide range and every milestone date agreed with the client.

tasks.how: Read the SOW draft against the kickoff notes and write down open questions for the client.
tasks.check: Every deliverable and date in the SOW matches what was said at kickoff.

tasks.how: Scan local media, press, TikTok, Instagram and Pinterest. Collect organic examples
tasks.tools: Press and local media, manual TikTok and Instagram search, Pinterest
tasks.check: Each signal has a source link; single-market and single-source signals are flagged.

tasks.how: List of creators on Instagram and TikTok plus brands list Record handle, platform, bucket and why they are on the list.
tasks.check: Every creator is LA based or has a clear LA link; brands sit in the same file.

tasks.task: Send the list and collect validation
tasks.how: Send the list to Client to validates
tasks.check: Written validation or edits received from the client.

tasks.how: Add, remove or reorder rows based on the client feedback; note what changed and why.
tasks.check: Every client edit is reflected and logged.

tasks.how: From the validated list, pick the TikToks and Instagram posts that show the formats, gestures and expressions worth reading. Gather the URLs, can expand beyond validated list as needed. Give Claude the URL list; it returns the filled sheet: creator, handle, platform, date, views, likes, followers, caption, hashtags, full transcript and a one line description of what happens.
tasks.tools: Manual TikTok and Instagram review / Claude, (scraper or data pull and transcript)
tasks.check: Videos come from the validated creators and the selection logic is written down.

tasks.how: Tag each video with the themes, formats, gestures and looks you decide on. Verbatims stay exactly as spoken.
tasks.check: Each video has the codes; no verbatim is paraphrased.

tasks.task: Read the sample and spot the patterns
tasks.how: Read across the videos and the initial brand and trend signals: what keeps coming back in formats, gestures, expressions and language.
tasks.check: Each pattern is backed by several videos and creators, not one viral post.

tasks.how: Write the storyline in Claude Docs. Writing rules: American English, every verbatim attributed to its creator, counts from VIEWS, no dashes.
tasks.check: Numbers in the doc match the sample sheet; every verbatim is attributed.

tasks.how: Review the storyline with team. Write down feedback and decide what to change.
tasks.check: Every comment has a decision.

tasks.how: share Storyline with the client to review
Map where the evidence is thin or missing: personas with few videos, topics with little support, white space the storyline needs filled.
tasks.check: Each gap is written down with the reason it matters.

tasks.how: Run the extra searches (for example [event] and [artist], LA nightlife) and send the new URLs. Keep targeted pulls out of core counts.
tasks.check: Search terms and dates written down; pulled videos tagged as targeted.

tasks.how: Check Pinterest and spate for hashtag and keywords signals
tasks.check: Screenshots dated; result mapped to the storyline.

tasks.how: Rework the storyline with the expanded sample and keep a log of what changed.
tasks.check: Every change is in the log; counts match the new sample.

tasks.how: List the hashtags used in the sample per persona and look, and propose extra hashtags from the creators' own words.
tasks.check: Proposed hashtags are marked as proposed; volumes checked in Spate before use.

tasks.how: Turn the storyline into a slide outline. and build claude prompt. collect Reference decks 5claude design system) the client Biannual Fragrance, Bold Beauty. Fonts: Bebas Neue and DM Sans.
tasks.check: Outline covers every section of the storyline and stays within 45 slides.

tasks.how: Work on the deck inside claude design artifacts for templae, styling, slide layout ect
Send the work in progress deck to Client and collect her feedback.
tasks.check: Feedback received in writing.

tasks.how: Take the draft out of Claude and rebuild it in PowerPoint as the working file.
tasks.check: Every slide from the outline exists in the file.

tasks.how: Edit and improve every slide, add imagery, link out; brands, Pinterest and Spate references, example TikToks with views, color.
tasks.check: Every slide reads on its own and follows the ID card template.

tasks.how: Read every slide line by line: wording, tone, verbatims exactly as spoken and attributed, American English, gender-neutral language, no dashes, the client brands in bold.
tasks.check: No unattributed verbatim; no paraphrased quote.

tasks.how: Send full finalized presentation to client to reveiw and provide feedback
tasks.check: Check in with project lead prior to to get sign off

tasks.how: Apply the agreed changes: persona distinctions, axis naming, #blonzer in place of #bronzerblush (check examples first), gender-neutral language.
tasks.check: Each agreed change is visible in the deck; [brand] confirms.

tasks.how: Deliver the final version (Nov 3) and present to the wider the client team (Nov 5).
tasks.check: Final file sent; presentation delivered.
